name: Ephemere
source: Ephemere_manual.pdf p3 (lettered panel diagram, jacks A-L), p1 (panel)
notes: Two mirrored channels: channel 1 on the left, channel 2 on the right. The panel prints INPUT / RECORD / PLAY|RES / SCAN / SPEED without numbers, so channel numbers were added. RECORD and PLAY/RES are trigger inputs; SCAN and SPEED are CV inputs. With nothing patched to INPUT, the INPUT pot acts as an offset/CV source.
